blocks.html: Buildings or portions thereof occupied as a nonproduction laboratory may be classified as a Group B occupancy provided they comply with the provisions of Section 427. Nonproduction laboratories not in compliance with the provisions of Section 427.7 for laboratory chemical quantity limitations shall be classified as Group H occupancy.
